title: assessing and quantifying perceived trust in interpretable clinical decision support
core_idea: Introduce a methodology that leverages fuzzy cognitive maps (FCMs) to elicit and quantify healthcare professionals' trust mental models for an interpretable machine learning clinical decision support system for COVID-19 diagnosis, and use a degree-of-agreement metric to validate the quantified perceived trust.
tldr: Proposes using FCMs to assess and quantify clinicians' perceived trust in an interpretable ML clinical decision support tool, with degree-of-agreement as a validation metric.
